column3: “Trembling he lifted up he in Israel” is rendered “there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel”; “became guilty” is rendered “did wrong.”

“Increase to sin” is rendered “sin more and more”; “those who offer sacrifice of humankind” is rendered “the men who sacrifice,” and NASB makes it “Let the men who sacrifice kiss the calves!” The meaning is uncertain.
“Rising early going” is rendered “which soon disappears,” and “window” “chimney.”
“From the land of Egypt” is rendered “Since the land of Egypt”; “you must not know” is rendered “you were not to know.”
“I knew you” is rendered “I cared for you.”
“According to their pasture” is rendered “As they had their pasture”; “exalted” is rendered “proud.”
“I became” is rendered “I will be”; “on a road I will watch” is rendered “I will lie in wait by the wayside.”
“The cavity of their heart” is rendered “their chests”; “lion” is rendered “lioness,” and NASB adds “would.”
“It will destroy you, O Israel, for in me, in your helper” is rendered “It is your destruction, O Israel, That you are against Me.” The meaning is uncertain.
“I may take away” is rendered “took him away.”
“If a time not he will present himself” is rendered “For it is not the time that he should delay at the opening of the womb.”
NASB renders both opening lines as questions, “Shall I ransom … ? Shall I redeem … ?”; “destruction” is rendered “sting.”
“A son of brothers” is rendered “among the reeds,” reading a different word; “fountain” renders “spring.”
MT 14:1. “Children” is rendered “little ones”; “its” is rendered “their.”
